locations.name: La Sala de l'Isaac
locations.description: Traditional Empordà dining room 2 minutes down the road from Mas Oller (15 from Mas Pastora) — regional cooking, grilled fish and seafood, and Pals rice; lunch 13:00–15:00. Schedule caveat that shaped the day plan: its live calendar shows TUESDAY CLOSED, Wednesday open — so it's the natural Wednesday pairing with the 5 PM terrace tasting, not the Tuesday tour day.

references.note: Best Wednesday traditional lunch (13:00–15:00), 2 min from the winery; live calendar marks Tuesday closed.

locations.geocode_query: La Sala de l'Isaac restaurant, Gi-652, Torrent, Girona, Spain

locations.name: El Pedró (Pals)
locations.description: Homemade Mediterranean cooking and Pals rice inside the medieval village — open for lunch Tuesday AND Wednesday (13:00–15:30), which makes it the designated post-tour lunch of the Tuesday Mas Oller plan: 11:00 English tour, 13:15 table here, then an hour wandering Pals's lanes. 7 minutes from the winery, 21 from Mas Pastora. Good regional food in a historic setting without another tasting-menu production.
locations.address: Carrer de les Placetes, 29, 17256 Pals, Girona, Spain

references.note: Best Tuesday choice: open Tue & Wed 13:00–15:30; a 13:15 reservation after the 11:00 tour leaves the afternoon for medieval Pals.

locations.geocode_query: El Pedro restaurant, Pals, Girona, Spain

locations.name: Can Nau
locations.description: Traditional Empordà cooking, seasonal dishes and Pals rice in an 18th-century rural house with a summer terrace in Peratallada — the casual, home-style Tuesday alternative if the stone village appeals more than Pals (open Tue ~noon–16:30, CLOSED Wednesday). Hours come from a local listing rather than a live calendar — confirm by phone before building the afternoon on it: +34 972 63 40 35. 11 minutes from the winery, 26 from Mas Pastora.
locations.address: Plaça dels Esquiladors, 2, 17113 Peratallada, Girona, Spain

references.note: Most casual/traditional Tuesday village option — 18th-century house, summer terrace; open Tuesday, closed Wednesday; confirm by phone (+34 972 63 40 35).

locations.geocode_query: Can Nau restaurant, Peratallada, Girona, Spain

locations.name: Candelaria (Peratallada)
locations.description: Creative shared plates in an old stone house on Peratallada's Carrer Major — relaxed, design-conscious, and the anchor of the best Wednesday sightseeing sequence: 13:00 lunch, explore Peratallada until ~16:25, then the 12-minute drive to Mas Oller's 5 PM tasting. Live calendar: Tuesday CLOSED, Wednesday lunch 13:00–15:00. 11 minutes from the winery, 25 from Mas Pastora.

references.note: Best Wednesday lunch + Peratallada combination: 13:00–15:00, then village until ~4:25, then the 5:00 tasting. Tuesday closed per live calendar.

locations.name: El Mas (Mas de Torrent)
locations.description: The restaurant of Relais & Châteaux Mas de Torrent, 3 minutes from Mas Oller — contemporary Catalan cooking with Empordà views from the farmhouse terrace. Open for lunch on BOTH Tuesday and Wednesday, making it the closure-proof polished option for either winery day; it will feel like a luxury-hotel meal rather than a village find, which is exactly its job as the reliable fallback. 19 minutes from Mas Pastora.
locations.address: Mas de Torrent Hotel & Spa, Afueras de Torrent, S/N, 17123 Torrent, Girona, Spain

references.note: Most polished option, open for lunch both dates; 3 min from the winery — solves any Tuesday/Wednesday closure concern.

locations.geocode_query: El Mas restaurant, Mas de Torrent Hotel, Torrent, Girona, Spain

locations.name: Mas Oller
locations.description: Countryside vineyard in Torrent, minutes from Mas de Torrent and ~15 from Llafranc — DO Empordà wines (crisp whites, Garnacha-driven reds) with tastings among the vines. The close-to-base winery of the Costa Brava leg (Celler Perelada is the far-north alternative), and a natural fit for the slow Sep 10 afternoon. Availability verified for the trip week (checked Aug 26): the ENGLISH GUIDED TOUR runs Tuesday Sep 8 at 11:00 only (90 min, €26 pp, includes tasting and local delicacies); Wednesday Sep 9 offers terrace tastings only (€15 pp, 1 h) at 1:30 and 5:00 PM — book the 5:00 and avoid the lunch-conflicting 1:30. Sixteen minutes' drive from Mas Pastora; both guests tasting means a pre-booked car or taxi legs (Taxi Palafrugell 24, WhatsApp +34 624 583 129; hotel reception also arranges transfers).
locations.address: Mas Oller s/n, Carretera, GI-652, Km.0, 230, 17123, Girona, Spain

references.note: Exact availability: Tue Sep 8 — English guided tour 11:00 + tastings 1:30/4:00/5:00; Wed Sep 9 — tastings 1:30/5:00 only. Guided visit ~90 min €26 incl. tasting and delicacies; terrace tasting 1 h €15.

locations.name: Vicus
locations.description: Contemporary Catalan cooking in Pals village — the itinerary reel's 'must-try for Catalan cuisine' dinner after a medieval-village wander. Joins Pahissa del Mas and Comedor Verdor in the Pals dinner cluster, 15 minutes from Llafranc. Day-plan detail for the winery week: NO Tuesday lunch service, but Wednesday lunch runs ~13:30–15:15 — a 1:30 table followed by the 5:00 Mas Oller tasting is the food-forward Wednesday sequence (4 minutes from the winery).
locations.address: Carrer Enginyer Algarra, 51, 17256 Pals, Girona, Spain

references.note: Best Wednesday food-forward lunch: no Tuesday lunch; Wednesday ~13:30–15:15; pairs with the 5:00 tasting.
Guide entry: contemporary takes on traditional Catalan cooking, rices for sharing.
